source_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_90/training_0.csv"

# Convert dog stage columns to boolean indicators (1 if not null, else 0)
doggo_count = df['doggo'].notnull().sum()
floofer_count = df['floofer'].notnull().sum()
pupper_count = df['pupper'].notnull().sum()
puppo_count = df['puppo'].notnull().sum()

# Sum all dog stage counts into dog_type
dog_type = doggo_count + floofer_count + pupper_count + puppo_count

# Create output dataframe with the target schema

# Write output
